# Shahab Gohar, AI Engineer

> Personal services site of Shahab Gohar: AI automation, CRM integration (SuiteCRM, Mautic), and custom software for small and mid-size businesses. Every project starts with a fixed written quote and a working demo in 14 days, or the client doesn't pay.

- [Services](https://shahabgohar.dev/services/): all service lines in one place

- [SuiteCRM development](https://shahabgohar.dev/services/suitecrm-development/): custom modules, plugins, workflows, and SuiteCRM 8 Angular work
- [Mautic and SuiteCRM integration](https://shahabgohar.dev/services/mautic-suitecrm-integration/): automated, de-duplicated lead sync

- [Projects](https://shahabgohar.dev/projects/): case studies with measured results
- [Blog](https://shahabgohar.dev/blogs/): SuiteCRM and AI engineering write-ups
- [The AI wrote the fix. I answered for it.](https://shahabgohar.dev/blogs/software-engineering-is-not-dead/): an AI-built fix for dropped calls on production voice bots passed every test but covered new bots only and skipped the diagnosed path (a script edit on bots that are already live), so 33 more calls dropped; what that shows about scoping, testing and accountability when building with AI coding tools, and why software engineering isn't dead
- [How to get into AI automation](https://shahabgohar.dev/blogs/how-to-get-into-ai-automation/): the full skill stack behind AI automation, from no-code tools and SQL to system design, RAG, and LLM observability, and the order to learn it
- [Google SSO in SuiteCRM 8](https://shahabgohar.dev/blogs/suitecrm-google-sso/): when SuiteCRM 8's built-in SAML sign-in is enough, and what a custom Google sign-in build adds: two sessions in one login, Gmail and Calendar access in one consent, automatic calendar sync, and the proxy detail that breaks OAuth
- [Move a MySQL InnoDB table to another disk](https://shahabgohar.dev/blogs/move-mysql-innodb-table-to-another-disk/): a production war story plus the supported MySQL 8.0 innodb_directories method for relocating a large tablespace off a full disk with zero data loss
- [Automation audit checklist](https://shahabgohar.dev/automation-audit/): 12 manual processes with yearly costs and the build that removes each
